notes_for_editor: Thin record: two lists give only 'Bull Lake, north of Massey' or 'Bull Lake Massey'. The Ontario LIO tower dataset (cached at data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson, OBJECTID 2508, ident SF-54, 'Boon Twp.') has a point at 46.444892, -82.128667, accurate to within 500 m, with no height, build date or status; it cannot be footnoted because the geohub page is script-only in our cache. That point is about 25 km north of Massey by my rough estimate, consistent with the list. The fan list's original oocities URL now returns 404; the cited copy is the geocities.ws archive, which is undated. Build, design, staffing and fires are unsourced and left out of the story. Check the record's 'Boon' name against the Boon Township naming if a fuller source turns up.
